headline: Declared City Hall Annex Historically Significant but not Preferably Preserved, allowing demolition to proceed
summary: The Commission reviewed a presentation on the Beverly City Hall Renovation & Expansion Project, which includes demolishing the 1938 City Hall Annex/Police Station while keeping its foundation. During a public hearing, the Commission voted that the Annex is Historically Significant but not Preferably Preserved, meaning no demolition delay will be imposed. The Commission also elected new officers and approved prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Deemed the 1938 City Hall Annex/Police Station at 191 Cabot Street Historically Significant due to its association with civic development; motion carried 6-0 by roll call vote.
Motion to deem the 1938 City Hall Annex/Police Station Preferably Preserved failed 0-6 by roll call vote (after Heath corrected his vote).
Elected William Finch as Chair and Suzanne LaMont as Vice Chair of the Commission; motion carried 6-0 by roll call vote.
Approved the January 28, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended; motion carried 6-0 by roll call vote.
Tabled discussion of the February 25, 2026 meeting minutes to the next meeting.
